npcs.name: 珞珥
npcs.look: 三十多岁的女子，背着两卷麻绳，靴子补过；说话前先用指节敲墙。
npcs.voice: 只讲判断，不讲故事；被夸就摆手。
greetings: first
你要进洞？先说回程。说不出来就别进。
revisit
还是你。绳子带了吗？没带就在洞口等。
night
夜里的洞比白天深。信不信由你。
chats: 洞不吓人，岔道吓人。岔道多的地方我不去。
我画路用石头，不用纸。纸会湿。
有人不听劝。他们的名字我不记。
site_lines: arrival
三步一停，听风。风停了就回头。
warning
左边那条岔口别进，尽头是竖井。
refusal
要我领你走全程？不走。我只带到第二处标记。

before: 你要找回去的路，先从洞口数标记。别急着往里走。
after: 路的事定了。洞口的风向照旧，我的标记也照旧。
early: 你先问过我回程，后去办的路。顺序对，人不容易丢。
late: 路的事办完了才想进洞？洞不认晚来的人，只认绳长。
proxy: 向导不在洞口时，石头标记别踢；那是别人的回程。

english.greet.first: Going in? Name your way back first. Can't name it, don't go.
english.greet.revisit: Still you. Rope with you? Without it, wait at the mouth.
english.greet.night: The cave is deeper at night. Believe it or not.
english.chat.1: The cave doesn't frighten me; forks do. Where forks multiply, I don't go.
english.chat.2: I draw roads with stones, not paper. Paper gets wet.
english.chat.3: Some don't take advice. I don't learn their names.
english.site.arrival: Three steps, pause, listen to the wind. Wind stops, turn back.
english.site.warning: Don't take the left fork. It ends in a shaft.
english.site.refusal: Lead you the whole way? No. I go as far as the second mark.
english.visit.before: Looking for the way back? Count the marks from the mouth first. Don't hurry inward.
english.visit.after: The road business is settled. The wind at the mouth is the same; so are my marks.
english.visit.early: You asked me about the way back before dealing with the road. Good order; people get lost otherwise.
english.visit.late: The road's settled and going in is next? The cave measures rope, not timetables.
english.visit.proxy: If the guide is missing, don't kick the stone marks. They're someone's way back.

npcs.name: 芩珥
npcs.look: 四十来岁的女人，背篓里垫着旧布，手指有草汁染出的褐痕；进洞前先把篓子放下。
npcs.voice: 说话慢，先报草名再谈别的；被催就停下来闻一闻。
knows: 哪几味草这个时节还有
not_knows: 不说自己采的草卖给谁
greetings: first
进洞前把篓子放下。洞里的土会认草味。
revisit
又是你。洞里那堆火是我熄的。
night
夜里不进洞。草不怕黑，我怕。
chats: 采药讲时候。早三天是药，晚三天是草。
洞里歇脚就歇脚，别把火留在苔上。
有人问我方子。我只报草名，不报剂量。
site_lines: arrival
脚踩干的那半边。湿的那边滑。
warning
别踢苔线，那是别人记的路。
refusal
要我带你采？不。采药靠眼，不靠带路。

before: 驿馆要的那味草，这个时节只有洞口阴面有。别乱采。
after: 药送到了。草还长在洞里，谁要就自己来采。
early: 你先来的洞口，后去的驿馆。顺序对，草不会认错。
late: 驿馆的事办完了才来采草？草不等单子，只等时节。
proxy: 采药的人不在洞口时，苔线别踩；那是别人的路。

english.greet.first: Set the basket down before you go in. The soil in there knows herb smells.
english.greet.revisit: You again. That fire in the cave was mine; I smothered it.
english.greet.night: No cave at night. Herbs don't fear the dark. I do.
english.chat.1: Picking is all about timing. Three days early it's medicine; three days late it's grass.
english.chat.2: Rest if you like, but don't leave a fire on the moss.
english.chat.3: People ask me for formulas. I give herb names, not doses.
english.site.arrival: Step on the dry half. The wet half slips.
english.site.warning: Don't kick the moss line. That's someone's road.
english.site.refusal: Take you picking? No. Picking is eyes, not a guide.
english.visit.before: The one herb the inn wants grows only on the shady side of the mouth. Don't pick it blind.
english.visit.after: The medicine went out. The herb still grows in there; whoever needs it can come.
english.visit.early: Your first stop was the mouth, the inn second. Right order; the herb won't be mistaken.
english.visit.late: So the inn is done and the herbs now? Herbs wait for the season, not for slips.
english.visit.proxy: With the picker gone from the mouth, don't step on the moss line.

npcs.name: 栎珥
npcs.look: 五十来岁的男人，肩上担着两根旧绳，裤脚用麻绳扎紧；走到根洞前先伸脚试地。
npcs.voice: 带笑，爱说树的年纪；谈到水就收起笑。
greetings: first
先伸脚试，再落脚。根洞不认人。
revisit
又是你。枯枝我昨天捡过一轮。
night
夜里不进来。根洞里的水夜里涨得快。
chats: 这棵树比我爷爷老。它还记得谁砍过它。
拾柴只拾枯的。活的砍一根，少一片荫。
有人拿树说事。树不说话，人就替它说。
site_lines: arrival
从东边绕。西边根上有青苔。
warning
洞底那圈水别看浅，底下是空的。
refusal
要我帮你砍活枝？不砍。要柴，枯枝够你背。

before: 钟站要修，用枯枝。别去砍活枝，砍了少一片荫。
after: 钟站修好了。枯枝照旧落，我照旧捡。
early: 你先来的根洞，后去的钟站。哪根是枯的，你分得清了。
late: 钟站的事办完了才来捡柴？枯枝不等检修，落下就是落下。
proxy: 拾柴的人不在时，别砍活枝；枯的够用。

english.greet.first: Test with your foot before you put weight down. The root hollow knows no faces.
english.greet.revisit: You again. I picked over the dead branches yesterday.
english.greet.night: Not in here at night. The hollow fills fast after dark.
english.chat.1: This tree is older than my grandfather. It still remembers who cut it.
english.chat.2: Gather dead wood only. Cut one live branch and you lose a patch of shade.
english.chat.3: People argue with trees as their evidence. The tree says nothing, so they speak for it.
english.site.arrival: Come round the east side. The west roots carry moss.
english.site.warning: That pool at the bottom looks shallow; underneath it's hollow.
english.site.refusal: Cut a live branch for you? No. Dead wood is enough for your back.
english.visit.before: The bell station needs mending; use dead wood. Don't cut live branches for it.
english.visit.after: The station is mended. Dead wood keeps falling, and I keep picking it.
english.visit.early: The hollow came first, the station second. You can tell dead from live now.
english.visit.late: So the station is mended and wood now? Dead wood falls when it falls, not when repairs finish.
english.visit.proxy: When the woodcutter is away, don't cut live branches. Dead wood will do.

npcs.name: 洄珥
npcs.look: 二十多岁的女人，靴子外裹着草绳，背着一根探路的长杆；说话前先看云。
npcs.voice: 看天说话，句子跟着风走；被问路就报水线不报方向。
greetings: first
看云再说话。云低，今天别下谷。
revisit
又是你。冲沟又宽了一掌。
night
夜里谷地起雾。雾里没有路，只有水声。
chats: 雨来得比人快。水线不会等你系鞋带。
我走谷地不图快，图看得见退路。
有人抄近路。近路在雨里会变成河。
site_lines: arrival
站到沟沿上。沟底是上一场雨的路。
warning
听见上游有闷响就上坡，别等水。
refusal
要我带你穿谷？不。绕半天，比捞人快。

before: 路标要立，先看水线。立在水线上，一场雨就没了。
after: 路标立起来了。冲沟也宽了，绕行的路得重画。
early: 你先问过我水线，后去立的路标。位置对得上。
late: 路标的事完了才来问谷地？雾不看路标，只看水声。
proxy: 行者不在谷口时，沟沿就是界线；别下沟底。

english.greet.first: Read the clouds before you speak. Low clouds, no valley today.
english.greet.revisit: You again. The gully is a palm wider.
english.greet.night: Fog rises in the valley at night. In fog there is no road, only water sound.
english.chat.1: Rain arrives faster than people. The water line won't wait for your bootlaces.
english.chat.2: I don't take the valley for speed. I take it to keep the way back in sight.
english.chat.3: Some take shortcuts. In rain a shortcut turns into a river.
english.site.arrival: Stand on the gully lip. The bottom is last storm's road.
english.site.warning: A dull rumble upstream means get uphill. Don't wait for the water.
english.site.refusal: Guide you across? No. Half a day around beats pulling a body out.
english.visit.before: Setting a signpost? Read the water line first. Set it on the line and one rain erases it.
english.visit.after: The signpost is up. The gully is wider too; the detour needs redrawing.
english.visit.early: You asked me about the water line before setting the sign. The spot lines up.
english.visit.late: The sign behind you, the valley now? Fog reads no signposts, only water sound.
english.visit.proxy: If the walker has left the valley mouth, the gully lip is the boundary. Don't go down.

boundary: 不把condition=after的台词画成无条件发生结果。
